$schema_comment: Grok Build hooks. Canonical guardrail logic lives in .claude/hooks/ and brain/hooks/; bin/run-claude-hook.sh only adapts payload and verdict shapes - never fork hook logic into a Grok-only copy. WINDOWS: replace `bash` in each command with Git Bash's full path (e.g. "C:/Program Files/Git/bin/bash.exe") - a bare bash can resolve to WSL, where HOME and every path are wrong. If your harness does not run hooks from the project root, make the script path absolute too. The sensitive-file check sets failClosed: Grok lets a tool call through when a hook cannot run, and a check that cannot start should refuse the edit instead - so on Windows, fix `bash` before your first edit or every edit is refused. No UserPromptSubmit hook is wired: Grok discards an allowing prompt hook's output (CLI 1.0.77), so brain/ context cannot be injected here - ask the agent to search the brain.
